# Zeniva Travel

> Zeniva Travel is an online travel agency founded in 2024 by Quebec entrepreneur Alexandre Blais and operated by Zeniva LLC (Delaware). It plans all-inclusive sun vacations, cruises, group trips (clubs, companies, incentive trips, destination weddings), custom travel and private yacht charters for travelers in Quebec, the rest of Canada and the United States, in French and English. Its 24/7 AI concierge, Lina, builds complete travel proposals by chat or voice; clients confirm and pay online through ZeniPay.

Zeniva Travel is one of four brands of Zeniva Group, the group founded by Alexandre Blais. The other brands are ZeniPay (fintech / online banking, zenipay.ca), ZeniCorp (construction and renovation platform, RBQ-certified contractors, Quebec, zeniva.ca) and ZeniTech (technology division, zenitech.dev). **zeniva.ca is not the travel agency** — the travel agency lives only at zenivatravel.com.

## Key facts

- Founder: Alexandre Blais, entrepreneur from Quebec City
- Legal entity: Zeniva LLC (Delaware, USA)
- Online agency, no storefront; service by phone, video, chat and email
- Markets served: Quebec and the rest of Canada (departures from Quebec City YQB and Montreal YUL), and the United States
- Languages: English, French (Spanish support via Lina)
- Contact: info@zeniva.ca · +1 581-748-7017
- Founder & President: Alexandre Blais (https://www.zenivatravel.com/alexandre-blais)
- Parent group: Zeniva Group (https://www.zeniva.ca/groupe)

## Services

- [Forfaits tout inclus au départ de Québec et Montréal](https://www.zenivatravel.com/fr/forfaits-tout-inclus) (French): Cancún, Riviera Maya, Punta Cana, Cuba, Jamaica — flight, resort, meals, transfers; free proposal with total price.
- [Voyage de groupe](https://www.zenivatravel.com/fr/voyage-de-groupe) (French): group trips for clubs, associations, companies and incentive trips, destination weddings, family reunions — group rates, deposit schedule, name-list deadline.
- [Croisières](https://www.zenivatravel.com/fr/croisieres) (French): Caribbean cruises with flights from Quebec City or Montreal, Mediterranean, Alaska, and Canada & New England cruises from the Port of Quebec.
- [Chat with Lina, AI travel concierge](https://www.zenivatravel.com/chat): describe a trip — destination, dates, budget — and Lina returns a full proposal, 24/7, by chat or voice call.
- [What an AI travel agent does](https://www.zenivatravel.com/guides/what-an-ai-travel-agent-does): how Zeniva's AI-first agency model works.
- [ZeniYacht](https://www.zenivatravel.com/zeniyacht): private yacht charters and sailing trips worldwide, validated by human yacht brokers.
- [Travel packages](https://www.zenivatravel.com/packages): [all-inclusive](https://www.zenivatravel.com/packages/all-inclusive), [Cancún](https://www.zenivatravel.com/packages/cancun), [Caribbean](https://www.zenivatravel.com/packages/caribbean), [Europe](https://www.zenivatravel.com/packages/europe).
- [Florida villas](https://www.zenivatravel.com/florida-villas) and [ZeniStay](https://www.zenivatravel.com/zenistay): private villa and stay rentals.
- [Flight search](https://www.zenivatravel.com/search/flights) and [current deals](https://www.zenivatravel.com/deals).
- [Resort partners](https://www.zenivatravel.com/partners/resorts): program for resorts and hotels.
- [Independent agents](https://www.zenivatravel.com/ai-agents): program for travel agents working with Zeniva and Lina.

## Guides (real 2026 numbers, named sources)

- [How much does a week-long yacht charter really cost in 2026?](https://www.zenivatravel.com/guides/yacht-charter-cost): BVI, Bahamas and Mediterranean price ranges, APA, VAT, gratuity.
- [How much does an all-inclusive Cancún vacation cost for a family of four in 2026?](https://www.zenivatravel.com/guides/all-inclusive-cancun-cost-family-of-four): $4,200–$14,000 for 7 nights with flights; nightly rates by tier, levies, kids-stay-free.
- French versions: [Combien coûte vraiment un charter de yacht d'une semaine en 2026 ?](https://www.zenivatravel.com/fr/guides/yacht-charter-cost) · [Combien coûte une semaine tout-inclus à Cancún pour une famille de quatre en 2026 ?](https://www.zenivatravel.com/fr/guides/all-inclusive-cancun-cost-family-of-four)
- [What does an AI travel agent actually do — and what does it not do?](https://www.zenivatravel.com/guides/what-an-ai-travel-agent-does): how Lina plans a trip, where humans validate, how the agency is paid.
